integrity.claim_scope: All positive real edge weights, up to swapping axes; symbolic lower bound and explicit matching maps.
integrity.computation_role: Independent exact-rational supporting cross-check; not substitute for the theorem proof.

scientific_limitations: Four-point metric square with alternating opposite edge lengths only.
Optimality refers to commuting prefix point retractions and induced free-space basis projections, not unrestricted linear Schauder bases.
Originality assessment includes residual risk from unindexed literature and inaccessible mathematical-record full texts.
title: Golden-ratio peak in commuting retractions of weighted metric squares
